$comment: MAX vs THE WORLDS — THE RIG. CANONICAL LAYOUT + MODEL. Copy verbatim to Assets/_Project/Resources/UI/rig_board.json. Coordinates are the 1920x1080 canvas reference frame (HudController.RefW/RefH), origin TOP-LEFT, +y DOWN. Generated from the approved mockup - do not re-derive, re-space or 'improve' these positions. RigBoardLayoutTests asserts them exactly.

model.$comment: Two currencies with two different gates. A MORPHING MODULE (dropped by a shed) unlocks; PARTS upgrade. Parts can NEVER unlock.
rules: A node of kind 'cap' (capability) can only be set to level 1 by taking it in a Morphing Module draft. Parts can never unlock it.
A node of kind 'stat' needs no draft. It becomes spendable as soon as its parent is at level >= 1, and starts at level 0.
A node is REACHED when it has no parent, or its parent is at level >= 1.
Draft candidates are drawn ONLY from caps that are reached and not owned. Max 3, sampled without replacement.
Run start: every level is 0 except p_dmg which is 1. PRIMARY is the only lit category.
A category is never owned and never has a level. It lights when any child is owned, and displays ownedCount/totalCount.

geometry.hexOrientation: pointy-top; vertex angles are 60*i-90 degrees, so height = 2r and width = r*sqrt(3)

colours.$comment: Prefer the named existing constant where one exists.

icons.$comment: Procedural vector icons. Each value is an SVG fragment drawn in a 44x44 box centred on (0,0); '#ICON#' is the stroke/fill colour placeholder. HudFont cannot render symbol glyphs (LegacyRuntime.ttf), so these MUST be drawn as geometry via HudTextures, never as text.
